blocks.content:
A Supreme Court judge can be removed only by impeachment.

Grounds:
• Proven misbehavior
• Incapacity

Procedure:
• Motion passed in both Houses of Parliament.
• Requires special majority.
A Supreme Court judge can be removed only by impeachment.

items: Impeachment requires a special majority in both Houses of Parliament, not a simple majority.
Remember the exact grounds for removal: 'Proven misbehavior' and 'Incapacity'.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: A Supreme Court judge can be removed exclusively through the process of impeachment.
The constitutional grounds for removal are restricted to proven misbehavior and incapacity.
The removal procedure requires an impeachment motion to be passed in both Houses of Parliament.
The motion must secure a special majority to successfully effectuate the judge's removal.
